profiles.label: PC
profiles.about: A laptop or desktop you use. Gets screens, apps, files and a hardware report by default.

profiles.label: Headless computer
profiles.about: A computer with no screen of its own (home server, mini PC). Inventory only until you grant more.

profiles.label: Cloud server
profiles.about: A rented server (for example Oracle Cloud). Inventory only by default, without personal state or MAIN eligibility. Enrollment does not install a gateway service.

guide.title: Join on the new machine

missing.why: A durable authority record (who is MAIN, with an epoch) that survives restarts. Today the main is only cluster.main_device in a config file.
A single compare-and-swap lease so two machines can never both act as MAIN.
The old main must be fenced: stop writing, drain, and acknowledge before the new one starts.
The target must prove it has the data and acknowledge the new epoch.
Every effect (jobs, memory, vault, queue) must check the epoch before it runs.
A fresh passkey or equivalent owner proof for this one action; phone pairing is not fleet admin.
Plans, runs and knowledge snapshots must be checkpointed so nothing is lost mid-move.

risks: Two machines acting as the main could both write memory and run jobs.
Editing cluster.main_device by hand moves no data and fences nothing.
main_preview.why: Safe main handoff (leases, fencing, owner proof) is not implemented, so nothing was changed.
